questions.text: What is the correct sequence of steps to deploy your completed LLM system as described in the capstone?
options: Buy a custom domain, write all your code at once, then test only on your own laptop before launch
Download the ZIP, create a GitHub repo, push the code, then deploy on Vercel
Deploy an empty project to Vercel first, then write the code, then push it to GitHub afterward
Email the code to yourself, open it on a spare server, then start the app by hand
questions.explanation: The capstone deployment follows a clear sequence: download your project as a ZIP, create a new GitHub repository, push your code there, and connect the repository to Vercel for automatic deployment. This gives you a live URL in minutes.

questions.text: How many stages does the complete ADD Academy LLM course cover?
options: 3 stages: Basics, Training, and Deployment
5 stages: Fundamentals through Fine-tuning
7 stages: LLM Fundamentals through GenAI SaaS
10 stages, roughly one for each month of the school year
questions.explanation: The ADD Academy course covers 7 main stages, progressing from LLM Fundamentals through Tokenization, Architecture, Training, Advanced Topics, Fine-tuning, and finally GenAI SaaS — plus the NeuralForge Platform stage that ties everything together.

questions.text: Which of the following are recommended next steps after completing the capstone? Select all that apply.
options: Experiment with different LoRA configurations on your model
Build additional SaaS products using the patterns you learned
Delete all of your code and start again from scratch in a totally different programming language
Explore commercial API integration for production-grade apps
questions.explanation: After the capstone, students are encouraged to continue experimenting with LoRA fine-tuning, build new SaaS products using the established patterns, and explore commercial API integration for production use. Deleting everything is not a recommended learning strategy.

questions.text: What is the purpose of connecting SaaS products to your deployed LLM system?
options: To make the LLM run faster by spreading its workload across many separate applications at once
To build end-user apps that use the LLM for tasks like image, text, or fact-checking
To replace the LLM entirely with much simpler rule-based systems
SaaS products simply cannot be connected to LLMs in any way
questions.explanation: Connecting SaaS products to your LLM creates practical applications that users can interact with. Each product (PixelForge, ClipCraft, ProseAI, TruthLens, DocMind) leverages the LLM for a specific use case, turning raw AI capability into user-friendly tools.

questions.text: Why is local development setup recommended before deploying to production?
options: Local development is actually required by law in most countries around the world today
It lets you test and debug quickly without affecting live users before you deploy
Local development is only for beginners, since professionals always deploy directly
It is cheaper because local computers use far less electricity than big data-center servers
questions.explanation: Local development lets you test and debug without affecting your live application. You can iterate quickly, catch bugs early, and verify that everything works before pushing changes to production where real users would be impacted.

questions.text: Care este secvența corectă de pași pentru a implementa sistemul LLM complet, așa cum este descris în proiectul capstone?
options: Cumperi un domeniu personalizat, scrii tot codul deodata, apoi testezi doar pe laptopul tau inainte de lansare
Descarca ZIP-ul, creeaza un depozit GitHub, trimite codul, apoi implementeaza pe Vercel
Implementezi un proiect gol pe Vercel intai, apoi scrii codul, apoi il trimiti pe GitHub
Trimite-ti codul prin email, deschide-l pe un server liber, apoi porneste aplicatia manual
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Implementarea capstone urmează o secvență clară: descarcă proiectul ca ZIP, creează un depozit GitHub nou, trimite codul acolo și conectează depozitul la Vercel pentru implementare automată. Aceasta îți oferă un URL live în câteva minute.

questions.text: Câte etape acoperă cursul complet ADD Academy LLM?
options: 3 etape: Baze, Antrenament si Implementare
5 etape: de la Fundamente la Ajustare fina
7 etape: de la Fundamentele LLM la GenAI SaaS
10 etape, cate una aproximativ pentru fiecare luna scolara
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Cursul ADD Academy acoperă 7 etape principale, progresând de la Fundamentele LLM prin Tokenizare, Arhitectură, Antrenament, Subiecte Avansate, Ajustare Fină și în final GenAI SaaS — plus etapa Platformei NeuralForge care leagă totul.

questions.text: Care dintre următorii sunt pași următori recomandați după finalizarea proiectului capstone? Selectează toate variantele corecte.
options: Experimenteaza cu diferite configuratii LoRA pe modelul tau
Construieste produse SaaS suplimentare folosind modelele invatate
Sterge tot codul tau si incepe din nou de la zero intr-un limbaj de programare complet diferit
Exploreaza integrarea API-urilor comerciale pentru aplicatii de productie
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: După capstone, studenții sunt încurajați să continue să experimenteze cu ajustarea fină LoRA, să construiască noi produse SaaS folosind modelele stabilite și să exploreze integrarea API-urilor comerciale pentru utilizare în producție. Ștergerea a tot nu este o strategie de învățare recomandată.

questions.text: Care este scopul conectării produselor SaaS la sistemul LLM implementat?
options: Sa faca LLM-ul sa ruleze mai repede distribuind sarcina pe multe aplicatii separate deodata
Sa creeze aplicatii care folosesc LLM-ul pentru imagini, text sau verificare
Sa inlocuiasca complet LLM-ul cu sisteme mai simple bazate pe reguli
Produsele SaaS pur si simplu nu pot fi conectate la LLM-uri
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Conectarea produselor SaaS la LLM-ul tău creează aplicații practice cu care utilizatorii pot interacționa. Fiecare produs (PixelForge, ClipCraft, ProseAI, TruthLens, DocMind) valorifică LLM-ul pentru un caz de utilizare specific, transformând capacitatea AI brută în instrumente prietenoase cu utilizatorul.

questions.text: De ce este recomandată configurarea dezvoltării locale înainte de implementarea în producție?
options: Dezvoltarea locala este de fapt ceruta de lege in majoritatea tarilor din lume astazi
Iti permite sa testezi si sa depanezi rapid fara a afecta utilizatorii live inainte de lansare
Dezvoltarea locala este doar pentru incepatori, caci profesionistii implementeaza mereu direct
Este mai ieftin deoarece computerele locale consuma mult mai putina electricitate decat serverele mari
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Dezvoltarea locală îți permite să testezi și să depanezi fără a afecta aplicația ta live. Poți itera rapid, descoperi erori devreme și verifica că totul funcționează înainte de a trimite modificările în producție unde utilizatorii reali ar fi afectați.

questions.text: Ποια είναι η σωστή ακολουθία βημάτων για την ανάπτυξη του ολοκληρωμένου συστήματος LLM σας όπως περιγράφεται στο capstone;
options: Agorazeis ena prosarmosmeno domain, grafeis olon ton kodika mazi, kai meta dokimazeis mono ston dikoi sou ypologisti prin tin ekkinisi
Katevaze to ZIP, dimiourgise ena GitHub repo, kane push ton kodika, kai meta anaptyxe sto Vercel
Anaptyxe ena adeio ergo sto Vercel prota, meta grapse ton kodika, kai meta kane push sto GitHub
Steile ton kodika me email ston eafto sou, anoixe ton se enan server kai xekina tin efarmogi cheirokinita
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Η ανάπτυξη capstone ακολουθεί μια σαφή ακολουθία: κατεβάστε το έργο σας ως ZIP, δημιουργήστε ένα νέο αποθετήριο GitHub, στείλτε τον κώδικά σας εκεί και συνδέστε το αποθετήριο με το Vercel για αυτόματη ανάπτυξη. Αυτό σας δίνει ένα ζωντανό URL σε λίγα λεπτά.

questions.text: Πόσα στάδια καλύπτει το πλήρες μάθημα ADD Academy LLM;
options: 3 stadia: Vasika, Ekpaideysi kai Anaptyxi
5 stadia: apo Themeliode mechri Mikrorythmisi
7 stadia: apo ta Themeliode LLM mechri GenAI SaaS
10 stadia, peripou ena gia kathe mina tis scholikis chronias
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Το μάθημα ADD Academy καλύπτει 7 κύρια στάδια, προχωρώντας από τα Θεμελιώδη LLM μέσω Tokenization, Αρχιτεκτονικής, Εκπαίδευσης, Προχωρημένων Θεμάτων, Μικρορύθμισης και τέλος GenAI SaaS — συν το στάδιο Πλατφόρμας NeuralForge που τα συνδέει όλα.

questions.text: Ποια από τα ακόλουθα είναι συνιστώμενα επόμενα βήματα μετά την ολοκλήρωση του capstone; Επιλέξτε όλα τα σωστά.
options: Peiramatisou me diaforetikes diamorfoseis LoRA sto montelo sou
Ftiaxe prostheta SaaS proionta chrisimopoiontas ta motiva pou emathes
Diagrapse olon ton kodika sou kai xekina apo tin arxi se mia entelos diaforetiki glossa programmatismou
Exereynise tin ensomatosi emporikon API gia efarmoges epipedou paragogis
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Μετά το capstone, οι φοιτητές ενθαρρύνονται να συνεχίσουν τον πειραματισμό με μικρορύθμιση LoRA, να κατασκευάσουν νέα SaaS προϊόντα χρησιμοποιώντας τα καθιερωμένα μοτίβα και να εξερευνήσουν ενσωμάτωση εμπορικών API για χρήση στην παραγωγή. Η διαγραφή τα πάντων δεν είναι συνιστώμενη στρατηγική μάθησης.

questions.text: Ποιος είναι ο σκοπός της σύνδεσης SaaS προϊόντων με το αναπτυγμένο σύστημα LLM σας;
options: Na kanei to LLM na trexei pio grigora katanemontas to fortio ergasias se polles xechoristes efarmoges taftochrona
Na dimiourgei efarmoges pou axiopoioun to LLM gia ergasies opos eikona, keimeno i elegxo gegonoton
Na antikatastisei enteloos to LLM me pio apla systimata vasismena se kanones
Ta SaaS proionta apla den mporoun na syndethoun me LLMs
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Η σύνδεση SaaS προϊόντων με το LLM σας δημιουργεί πρακτικές εφαρμογές με τις οποίες μπορούν να αλληλεπιδράσουν οι χρήστες. Κάθε προϊόν (PixelForge, ClipCraft, ProseAI, TruthLens, DocMind) αξιοποιεί το LLM για μια συγκεκριμένη περίπτωση χρήσης, μετατρέποντας την ακατέργαστη δυνατότητα AI σε φιλικά προς τον χρήστη εργαλεία.

questions.text: Γιατί συνιστάται η ρύθμιση τοπικής ανάπτυξης πριν την ανάπτυξη στην παραγωγή;
options: I topiki anaptyxi einai stin pragmatikotita apaitoumeni apo ton nomo stis perissoteres xores simera
Sou epitrepei na dokimazeis kai na aposfalmatoneis grigora choris na epireazeis zontanous xristes
I topiki anaptyxi einai mono gia arxarious, afou oi epaggelmaties anaptyssoun panta apeftheias
Einai fthinotero epeidi oi topikoi ypologistes katanalonoun poly ligoteri energeia apo tous megalous diakomistes
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Η τοπική ανάπτυξη σας επιτρέπει να δοκιμάζετε και να αποσφαλματώνετε χωρίς να επηρεάζετε τη ζωντανή εφαρμογή σας. Μπορείτε να επαναλαμβάνετε γρήγορα, να εντοπίζετε σφάλματα νωρίς και να επαληθεύετε ότι όλα λειτουργούν πριν προωθήσετε αλλαγές στην παραγωγή όπου πραγματικοί χρήστες θα επηρεαστούν.
